_title: Metin2 Okey Web Test Game | Sogepps
_description: Metin2 Okey web test game: practice with the helper tile-closing board and the list of the highest remaining combinations.
hero_lead: Track the tiles in the helper panel, then practice your scoring logic by playing the game below.
helper_sub: Tap a tile to flip it face down and white. Closed tiles are removed from the count.
combos_sub: Ranking based on the tiles still open in the helper game.
hint_delete_note: Right-click the top card to discard it.
combos2_sub: Moves still in the deck that lead to the golden chest. The list shrinks as you discard cards.
